prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: standalone pre-generated static demonstration image for a photo workbench.
Primary request: 将照片重绘为层叠纸雕，保留主体与构图，深蓝与苔绿配色，纸张纤维清晰，柔和侧光。
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target: the close-up café photograph showing a gooseneck kettle pouring into the central Chemex-style coffee brewer. Image 2 is only a visual material/style reference: the accepted rich layered paper sculpture. Transfer its paper craftsmanship, fibers, deep shadows, palette and warm side light to the coffee scene in Image 1; do not transfer landscape subject matter.
Recreate the whole coffee photograph as a handcrafted dimensional layered cut-paper relief. Preserve the original subject, object positions, relative sizes, close-up crop and viewpoint: the central transparent hourglass pour-over coffee brewer with dark coffee at the bottom, brown tied collar, white folded filter above, gooseneck metal kettle at upper right tilted toward the filter, hand holding it from the top edge, a second smaller brewer behind to the right, a bowl at lower left, counter at bottom, cropped arm at lower right, and soft café equipment shapes behind to the left. Preserve the 9:7 source aspect ratio, target approximately 1800 x 1400 or nearest supported size.
Style/medium: the same rich layered paper sculpture as Image 2. Every object built from many separate precisely cut and subtly torn paper planes with visible thickness, layered overlaps, slightly lifted edges, deep physical paper shadows and tactile natural paper fibers and crinkles. Represent the reflective kettle and glass shapes with folded ivory, muted grey, dark navy and translucent-looking layered pale blue paper; rich moss green, olive and deep-blue paper environment; cream filter with folded paper pleats; dark coffee in stacked warm brown paper. Soft warm side light highlights cut edges and casts convincing dimensional shadows. Clearly a real handcrafted paper coffee scene, materially transformed and sculptural, not a photographic color filter, flat illustration, painting or texture overlay.
Constraints: Only the transformed coffee artwork, edge-to-edge. Preserve the café composition from Image 1. No landscape, fjord, mountains, extra objects, user interface, comparison divider, split line, slider, labels, captions, writing, text, frame, watermark or logo.
